name: Add or Update Subscriber
description: Adds a new subscriber to an audience or updates existing subscriber. [See docs here](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/list-members/add-or-update-list-member/)

configurable_props.name: listId
configurable_props.label: List Id
configurable_props.description: The unique ID of the list

configurable_props.name: subscriberHash
configurable_props.label: Subscriber
configurable_props.description: The MD5 hash of the lowercase version of the list member's email address.

configurable_props.name: skipMergeValidation
configurable_props.label: Skip merge validation
configurable_props.description: If skip_merge_validation is true, member data will be accepted without merge field values, even if the merge field is usually required. This defaults to False.

configurable_props.name: statusIfNew
configurable_props.label: Status if new
configurable_props.description: Subscriber's status. This value is required only if the email address is not already present on the list.

configurable_props.name: emailType
configurable_props.label: Email type
configurable_props.description: Type of email this member asked to get ('html' or 'text').

configurable_props.name: mergeFields
configurable_props.label: Merge fields
configurable_props.description: An individual merge var and value for a member.

configurable_props.name: interests
configurable_props.label: Interests
configurable_props.description: The key of this object's properties is the ID of the interest in question.

configurable_props.name: marketingPermissionId
configurable_props.label: Marketing permission ID
configurable_props.description: The ID for the marketing permission on the list.

configurable_props.name: marketingPermissionsEnabled
configurable_props.label: Marketing permissions enabled
configurable_props.description: If the subscriber has opted-in to the marketing permission.

configurable_props.name: ipSignup
configurable_props.label: IP signup
configurable_props.description: IP address the subscriber signed up from.

configurable_props.name: timestampSignup
configurable_props.label: Timestamp signup
configurable_props.description: The date and time the subscriber signed up for the list in ISO 8601 format.

configurable_props.name: ipOpt
configurable_props.label: IP opt in
configurable_props.description: The IP address the subscriber used to confirm their opt-in status.

configurable_props.name: timestampOpt
configurable_props.label: Timestamp opt in
configurable_props.description: The date and time the subscriber confirmed their opt-in status in ISO 8601 format.
